label: b11 HOF confirm: every checkpoint >=99/5,000 at 30,000 episodes, seed 7
notes: Every b11 checkpoint at >=99 in the hof5000 pass, re-measured at the hall-of-fame depth on seed 7, the seed no selecting pass used, so a row here is a confirmed rate rather than a selected high. above:99:hof5000 reads each arm's hof5000 file; an arm with no row at 99 there selects nothing and its shards exit at once, which is why the policy list is the whole hof5000 set rather than a hand-picked winners list (b9's was hand-picked after its pass landed). Priority 6 so it dispatches only after b11-hof5000 (priority 5) has written those files. Labelled hof30k so neither earlier pass is touched. Ranks candidates, promotes nothing. Size unknown until hof5000 lands; b9's 727 candidates gave 33 rows, ~1M episodes, ~10 min at 16 shards. The record to beat is b5h at 98.96 /30,000.
